mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_task(record_type,task_domain,rule_id,test_mode,task_key,task_status,domain_status,matched,input_snapshot,output_snapshot,snapshot_retention_until,sample_size,external_notifications_sent,user_id,completed_at) VALUES('ALERT_RULE_TEST','ALERT_GOVERNANCE',#{row.ruleId},'SIMULATION',CONCAT('ALERT_RULE_TEST:',UUID()),'COMPLETED','COMPLETED',#{row.matched},CAST(#{row.inputJson} AS JSON),CAST(#{row.resultJson} AS JSON),DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 365 DAY),#{row.sampleSize},0,#{row.actor},NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id raw_id,COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) id,rule_id,test_mode mode,domain_status status,matched,sample_size,external_notifications_sent,created_at,completed_at,user_id FROM t_ai_task WHERE record_type='ALERT_RULE_TEST' AND id<#{before} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
